answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in canyon and terrace lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the horizon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1270 impostors cost 489 times the honest price and take 23 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
